A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CRL research work. Their text, equations, figures, tables, and complete appendices A–E are readable and can be reliably matched across the pagination changes.

before.justification: v1 reports original CRL experiments on customized few-shot learning, clustering, similarity retrieval, and fashion retrieval, together with sensitivity analyses and ablations.

after.justification: v2 retains the original classification and retrieval results in Tables 1–4 and the supplementary experiments and ablations in Appendices A–E.

M1.justification: The LLM-generated textual basis, VLM encoding, projection R = IT^T, and Algorithm 1 remain unchanged. The added description of normalized image embeddings clarifies implementation without establishing a changed procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate Clevr4-10k and Cards for customized classification, GeneCIS under the Focus and Change retrieval settings, and DeepFashion for fashion retrieval. No dataset, criterion, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in Tables 1–4. Both versions include CLIP, ALIGN, MetaCLIP, and BLIP2 in classification comparisons; CC, SCAN, and Multi-Map for clustering; and the same retrieval baselines, including Combiner and RPF.

E3.justification: The few-shot settings, logistic regression and k-means procedures, backbone configurations, retrieval metrics, dataset splits, and two-stage fashion-retrieval training protocol are unchanged. v2 does not report a revised experimental setting.

E4.justification: The textual-basis size analyses, Figure 8's representation visualization, and Appendix E ablations of LLM choice, temperature, and LLM/VLM prompts are retained unchanged. No new robustness test or supplementary analysis appears.

E5.justification: Both versions report 20 training-set selections for few-shot learning and 20 k-means runs, with averaged results. Tables 10–13 retain the same uncertainty entries and Std columns; no statistical reporting practice or run count changes.

E6.justification: The numerical entries and reported findings match throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 3 retains CLIP+CRL mean recalls of 26.8 and 32.6 for the original and fine-tuned weights, respectively, and Table 4 retains trained CRL mean MAP of 11.33.

T1.justification: The basis definition, relaxation of linear independence, Equations (1)–(6), and appendix retrieval-score construction are unchanged. The added explanatory sentences introduce no new mathematical reasoning, formal result, or proof.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, contribution statements, and conclusion retain the same claims about criterion-conditioned representations, basis transformation, interpretability, computational efficiency, and applicability across customized tasks.

C2.justification: The interpretations of classification, retrieval, and robustness results remain unchanged. Section 5 retains the limitations concerning shape-based clustering performance and the approximate textual basis, including unsuccessful attempts at universally effective text filtering.

D1.justification: Section 3.2 in v2 explicitly states that images X pass through the VLM image encoder to obtain normalized representations I before projection; v1 presents Equation (3) without this explanation. This adds a normalization detail, while appendix settings, hardware disclosure, prompts, and the code-access link remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion and all 74 references are unchanged. CRL's positioning relative to conventional representation learning, task-conditioned approaches, and conditional similarity methods is retained.

P1.justification: Section 3.2 gains a short introductory transition and an explanatory sentence before Equation (3). The remaining narrative and section organization are unchanged; most apparent textual movement results from page reflow.

P2.justification: Existing displays are repositioned or resized: Algorithm 1 moves from page 5 to page 6, Table 1 moves from page 6 to page 7, and Figure 6 becomes smaller. Captions and display contents remain unchanged, and the appendices retain identical layouts apart from page numbers.

improvement.justification: v1 opens Section 3.2 directly with Equation (3), whereas v2 explains the encoding step and explicitly identifies I as normalized image representations. This provides a small but useful improvement in methodological clarity and reproducibility. The empirical evidence, claims, and appendix analyses remain unchanged.
